properties: Full received boleto only; identity, tenant, Admin, version, amount and current provider evidence checked.
One durable submission; replay returns the same operation and cannot create a second provider POST.
Specific bankSlip/refund transport; no generic refund fallback; redirects rejected.
Private payer link validates HTTPS, exact Asaas host and environment; no link in command/replay, generic order DTO or audit logs.
Lost response, invalid link or audit persistence failure stays under review; later DONE plus REFUNDED can complete.
Boleto waiting for payer input may have a complete empty refund history only with a saved valid submission link.
Financial completion clears the link; no premature points or stock reversal.
Refund after delivery preserves committed stock until physical inspection.
Late payment on a cancelled order is refunded without reopening inventory or awarding points.
Origin rejection, JSON input, tenant isolation and no-store Admin read validated.
BOLETO_READY prevents old READY-only workers from using the generic refund transport; database rejects rearming submitted/completed operations.
deploymentRequirements: Review and CI of the actual commit before integration/deploy.
Apply migration under the existing backup/deployment procedure before starting the new runtime.
Align web, reconciliation and inbox consumers to the same approved artifact before the controlled sandbox test.
Preserve checkout pause, traffic and scheduler controls until the coordinated window.
Rollback preserves column, operations and evidence; never convert BOLETO_READY to READY.
pending: Actual account eligibility and PAYMENT_REFUND:WRITE permission.
Actual provider response URL and payer-document flow completion in Sandbox.
Coordinated new test order, transport/webhook, notification/alert receipt and operator acceptance.
Recovery of a missing payer link requires provider assistance; automatic link recovery is not implemented.
No partial refunds, debit implementation or document upload/storage in this delivery.
